## What's fixed

- Fixed the stage 3-8 Lunar ending taking minutes to complete after Marina
  flies away. The camera's widened logical boundary was following her beyond
  the authored arena instead of allowing the scripted exit to fire.
- Original 4:3 and cinematic gameplay now retain the game's authored camera
  boundaries, while widened actor culling remains active during real
  widescreen gameplay.

## What's new

- Vertigo and Seasick Climb now honor the widescreen preference and render
  their rotating rooms across the expanded field instead of remaining
  pillarboxed.
- The rotating-stage regression harness now verifies the requested runtime
  aspect mode in addition to textures, geometry, and motion stability.

## Validation

- Reproduced Lunar's grounded defeat and complete ending path in both 4:3 and
  widescreen. The right boundary remained fixed at the authored value and both
  runs transitioned normally to stage completion.
- Captured and inspected 64 moving widescreen frames each in Vertigo and
  Seasick Climb; both expanded-mode gates passed.
- Rebuilt the game and passed all telemetry, controls, and session-log tests.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/ThiagoLira/trouble-makers-pc-recomp/compare/v0.5.0...v0.6.0
